prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving interface–outbound-load release; accuracy/dispatch/safety/inventory compliance; no explicit modes. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass) owns inventory/locations/eligibility/shipments/tasks/priorities; produces Slot Reservation Receipt, sends Dispatch Wave Amendment, consumes Oversize Load Advisory, blocks incompatible allocations. Allocation requires availability/access/count/inspection/door-release and dimensional/mass/handling/clearance suitability. Mismatches block automation; holds retain reason, scan, detection-time, last-confirmed location until validated disposition. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook) validates/directs arrivals, records discrepancies, blocks risk; consumes Trailer Seal Exception Note from Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay). Desk checks identifiers/seals/paperwork/counts before unloading, segregates damage, consumes inspection-stage advisory, records proceed/rework/hold. Held pallets remain segregated until validated review; Inbound Pallet Buffer staging implies no inventory acceptance. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) supplies dimensions/Oversize Load Advisory, not placement authorization. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane perform zoned storage/retrieval; cross-aisle moves controlled. North consumes reservation receipt, checks task/destination/access before moving, sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; stale reports block induction. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor route separately. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) requires identification/inspection/sensors/downstream readiness, single-pallet merges; produces/validates Transfer Induction Ticket; holds duplicates/uncertain transfers, preserves recovery order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur) requires vehicle/route/destination availability and safety/access compliance; confirms pickup, produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) records inspection/authorizer, produces Crane Service Release Card. North reports positioning/load-retention/braking/travel faults; unavailable during inspection/adjacent-equipment verification. Service requires recorded fault, controlled area, maintenance/live-movement separation; failed tests retain inhibition/requeue diagnosis; successful tests still require interlock/limit checks. Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice; Safety Zone Controller and panel retain stop/restriction authority. Outbound Dispatch Sorter follows authorized amendments/current plan. Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces Gross Weight Variance Slip outside tolerance; reweigh/documented-safe-disposition resolves. Shipping Documentation Desk uses confirmed pallet/destination data. Warehouse Operations Supervisor escalates unresolved holds, checks delay impacts

New part:
S172: A recovery response begins when a position discrepancy, obstruction, or safety alarm makes continued automatic movement uncertain.
S173: Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller retain authority to stop or restrict movement whenever their safety status requires it.
S174: Safety Zone Controller establishes a controlled boundary around the affected aisle and prevents new equipment from entering it.
S175: Warehouse Operations Supervisor verifies that personnel are clear of the boundary before authorizing recovery work.
S176: Conveyor Line Controller holds transfers that could feed material into the isolated area.
S177: Morrowglass, the Warehouse Management System, receives the occupancy snapshot for recovery planning.
S178: Warehouse Management System reconciles its location records with available sensor data before it presents a recovery plan.
S179: Velvetrook applies the yard exception by holding affected vehicle movements outside the recovery boundary.
S180: Yard traffic remains under controlled access until the aisle is confirmed safe for normal operations.
S181: The recovery plan identifies the permitted travel envelope, the expected stopping point, and the conditions that require an immediate stop.
S182: South Aisle Stacker Crane performs a controlled recovery maneuver at reduced speed within the isolated aisle.
S183: The maneuver uses only the travel needed to reach a stable position or clear the obstruction under review.
S184: Personnel remain outside the crane travel envelope throughout the maneuver.
S185: A spotter may observe from a protected location but does not enter the isolated aisle while motion is enabled.
S186: Any unexpected movement, loss of position confidence, or renewed alarm causes an immediate stop and reassessment.
S187: Safety Zone Controller maintains the boundary until the cause of the stop has been understood and the recovery plan has been checked again.
S188: Inbound Pallet Buffer remains unavailable to new receipts when its access path intersects the isolated area.
S189: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor remain stopped where their movement could compromise the boundary.
S190: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives a hold instruction for routes that approach the recovery area.
S191: Maintenance Release Terminal records the inspection outcome and any repair work required before equipment can return to service.
S192: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reconciles outstanding exceptions, maintenance holds, and access constraints before releasing normal work.
S193: A controlled test confirms that the equipment responds correctly to stop commands and that its reported position is stable.
S194: The isolation boundary is removed only after the test passes and the aisle is clear of personnel and loose material.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
